name: Provision
overview: Scripture reveals God's faithful provision for His people, assuring that those who diligently obey His commandments will be exalted and cared for (Deuteronomy 28:1). The righteous are not forsaken nor left begging, as God intimately knows their days and secures an eternal inheritance for them (Psalms 37:18, 25). Believers are encouraged to seek God's kingdom first, trusting that all necessary provisions will be added to them (Matthew 6:33), and to find contentment in every circumstance by relying on God's sustaining strength (Philippians 4:11; Psalms 46:1).
